name: claude-zero
description: Working prototype of the Claude Code door to Skill Zero under the Skill Heaven umbrella, actively tested for public use — /skill-zero owns boot-time off|low|med; the launcher also ships the axis commands /skill-heaven, /skill-hell, and /skill-ultra, with /skill-hell as the live Hell summon door. Interfaces may change. The off-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package's launcher, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.
